text: AI Engineer World's Fair 2027: June 29 - July 1, San Francisco AIE Home World's Fair 2026 Get Updates JUNE 29 – JULY 1, 2027 • MOSCONE WEST, SAN FRANCISCO JUNE 29 – JULY 1, 2027 • SF, CA AI Engineer World's Fair 2027 Returns to Moscone After welcoming 7,500 attendees in 2026, we’re targeting 10,000 AI engineers, founders and technical leaders in 2027. Join us at Moscone West June 29–July 1 for technical tracks, workshops, an AI tools expo and conversations with the people building AI. Full program, speakers, and tickets announcing soon — join the list to be the first to know. >_ Submit No spam. Just World's Fair 2027 launch, CFP, and early-bird updates. Target attendance 10,000 San Francisco, CA Moscone West 2027 Jun 29 – Jul 1 Target attendance 10,000 San Francisco, CA Moscone West 2027 Jun 29 – Jul 1 The World's Fair experience More of what brought us together The core format returns in 2027: deep technical content, hands-on learning and a place to meet the people building AI. The detailed schedule, track lineup, speakers and exhibitors will be announced. Technical tracks & keynotes Go deep on building and shipping AI alongside engineers and researchers. The 2026 program spanned agents, evals, inference, retrieval, multimodality and more; the 2027 track lineup is still to come. Hands-on workshops Work through practical techniques and tooling, with sessions for experienced developers getting into AI and engineers taking production systems further. AI tools expo & live demos Meet the teams behind AI tools, models and infrastructure. Explore products, ask technical questions and see what is possible in live demos. AI leadership Join CTOs, VPs of AI and technical leaders to discuss building AI teams, choosing architectures and bringing AI into the enterprise. Hallway conversations & side events Connect with engineers, founders and researchers between sessions and at community gatherings around San Francisco. The 2027 side-event calendar will follow. Moscone West, San Francisco Return to the same venue for a gathering built around learning, meeting collaborators and seeing the breadth of AI engineering in one place.
